assessments.canonical_definition: Historical reported EBITDA bridge; no adjustment is present
assessments.issuer_definition: Revenue less operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization; adjusted equals reported

citations.quote: Reported EBITDA equals revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization. Each reported quarter and FY2025 use this definition. Adjusted EBITDA equals reported EBITDA because there are no adjustments.
